body:
WINDOW 82 - M5 LANE, the direct-attack reduction route (b), the overlap model in action (W82 ran while the 0391 M2 dual literature audit landed; the per-unit critical path is max(run, formalization)).

CERTIFICATION (three layers, 0348 process rule: no formal module before the seam audit passes): (1) ENVIRONMENT REPEAT - established (CE2 header); (2) PIPELINE RUN: code/window.py on a = 12 363 155 077 115 (= b81), b requested = 12 363 155 097 115, M = 60, C_R = 1, 32 workers, 34 249 evaluations, 2 639.7 s, resumed_from_cache = 537 823 (seeded from window82_b82.json.cache.jsonl - the seventeenth overlap run; the wall-time series is stable at about 2 500-2 650 s). THE SNAP: the requested endpoint was not a good Gram point at working precision, so the pipeline snapped b down by exactly 1 - certified width b - a = 19 999. This is the THIRD SNAP in the series (after W1 and W78); W2-W77, W79, W80, W81 were non-snapped. (3) VERIFIER (code/verify_window.py on window82_b82.json): CERTIFIED: true, turing_ok: true, points_checked = 34 249, sign_changes_inside = 19 999 (the SNAPPED width), roser_failures_inside = 2, roser_run_left_of_a = 48, roser_run_right_of_b = 50 (both >= K_conservative = 12), 0 cross-check failures (all 34 249 records), 0 undetermined Gram signs, endpoints recomputed and matched. SEAM AUDIT: the recorded g_a82 dyadic ball [116063676365564510870725129711800949101, -85, 16777217, -110] is BIT-IDENTICAL to CE81's recorded g_b81 (exact tuple comparison, 2026-11-13).

THE TWO RECORDED Rosser FAILURES (RESCUE - both ultimately determined; RECORDED, not suppressed): block 1 - naive [12 363 155 080 151, 12 363 155 080 154] (need = 3, changes = 1, points = 193, m = 64), union [12 363 155 080 150, 12 363 155 080 155] (need = 5, found = 5, m = 8, determined); block 2 - naive [12 363 155 092 836, 12 363 155 092 838] (need = 2, changes = 0, points = 129, m = 64), union [12 363 155 092 835, 12 363 155 092 840] (need = 5, found = 5, m = 2, determined). The second block is noteworthy as the first NAIVE block with changes = 0 (zero sign changes in the naive 129-point sample) to be resolved by a 6-point union window - the rescue mechanism working as designed at a genuinely degenerate block.

ENDPOINT DECODE: g_b82 = [116063676546330893270056314737404147635, -85, 16777217, -110] (exact dyadic tuple authoritative): 3 000 175 720 648.4518695961402317031720884521342180314461083566468513339486889890395104885101318359375 + or - 1.29e-26 (radius 16777217 x 2^-110). The endpoint ball STAYS normalized at exponent -85 (sequence: -86 ..g_b78, -85 g_b79, -84 g_b80, -85 g_b81, -85 g_b82). The floor tCE82 = 3 000 175 720 648 sits 0.4518695961... above the integer boundary - robust by many orders of magnitude. The standard two-decimal lower bound gB82Lo = 3 000 175 720 648.45 has the exact margin 0.00186959614023170317208843920952018993 (integer-tuple arithmetic) - THIN (third case: W79 1.76e-4, W81 4.03e-4, W82 1.87e-3); cent-granularity luck of the endpoint, not a precision danger (radius thirteen orders smaller); no pattern claimed on thin margins. No CASING (0.45 != floor; W38/CE38 remains the only CASING case).

MILESTONES (machine): increment tCE82 - tCE81 = 4 673 - the USUAL STEP NOTWITHSTANDING THE SNAP: the endpoint sits 0.4519 above the boundary and one more Gram unit (about 0.25 real units of Im s) would not have crossed it, so the snap took exactly one zero and zero floor units. Frontier tCE82 - WinC.tPT2 = 387 848: the 375 000 UNIT MILESTONE (crossed in W80 at 378 502, margin 3 502 - the second prediction of the series, ACHIEVED) CARRIES with margin 12 848; the 350 000 mark (crossed W74 - the first prediction, delivered exactly) CARRIES with margin 37 848; the 325 000 / 300 000 marks carry 62 848 / 87 848; the 400 000 round mark is 12 152 ahead - the projected hi values w83 = 392 521 and w84 = 397 194 both remain BELOW 400 000, so W85 remains the predicted crossing window absent snaps (compute from the decoded endpoint, do not pre-announce). CENSUS: 1 639 985 + 19 999 = 1 659 984 - the snap took exactly ONE zero (0390's non-snapped prediction was 1 659 985 - delivered 1 659 984, exactly one short, as a snap takes); the 1 600 000 CERTIFIED-ZERO MARK (crossed in W80 - the double-convergence partner of the 375 000 unit milestone) CARRIES with margin 59 984; the 1 500 000 mark carries 159 984; the 1 700 000 mark is 40 016 ahead (about 9 windows - around window 91 absent snaps). No new frontierPast theorem (no new unit-frontier round mark in W82; census milestones are documented, not theorem-ized, per the 0356 convention).

FORMAL (CE82.lean, green 8848 targeted / 17454 full tree): import RhAttack.CE81; open line gains CE81 (established pattern: CE(N)'s open line carries up to CE(N-1)); namespace CE82. Constants gB82Lo = 300017572064845/100, tCE82 = 3000175720648; frontierGapAboveH0 re-anchored (387 848); all eight PAST-mark theorems (175k..350k plus the carried 375k) re-anchored at tCE82 with the exact 387 848 fact (count 8 verified); frontierPast350k re-anchored through EIGHT face shrinks (4673 x 7 + 4672 = 37 383; 387 848 - 37 383 = 350 465 at the WINDOW-74 frontier - the crossing record stays true); bandOfWindows82 with clauses h1..h83 (h83 = the W82 terminal slice ce82WinClause over (gB81Lo, tCE82]; the W81 FULL slice re-cited as ce81WinClauseFull); allOnLineUpToCE82; terminalFaceCE82 (the NAMED residual, stated at Im s > tCE82 = 3 000 175 720 648); faceCE81_implies_faceCE82; terminalFaceCE82_iff_faceCE81 (iff RHS = CE81.terminalFaceCE81; the face-advancement line 'exact faceCE81_implies_faceCE82 q' is the recurring typo locus and was directly verified); rh_split_at_CE82; rh_reanchored_CE82. Doc sweep 22/22 single-line docs (ce82_docsweep.py; doc-anchor invariants verified: WINDOW 81 FULL -> def ce81WinClauseFull, WINDOW 82 TERMINAL -> def ce82WinClause, 375k doc -> frontierPast375k); stale W81 scans clean (383 175, 378502-era language absent; 1 639 985 appears only in the header's legitimate 0390-prediction citation; 1 619 985 appears only in the three legitimate W80-crossing historical citations). NO RH CLAIM preserved (7 occurrences).

PROCESS NOTE (bug caught by the build, recorded for the ledger): the CE82 generator emitted the header doc comment with the wrong opener - the three characters slash-STAR-bang ('/*!') instead of the CE-series header convention of slash-DASH-bang ('/-!') with closer slash-dash ('-/'). The slash-star-bang head lexes as a C-style comment requiring a slash-star closer that occurs nowhere in the file, so the first build failed with a parse error inside the header text (Lean: unexpected token ';' at line 200 - the first semicolon after the header should have ended). Fix: replace the opening sequence slash-star-bang with slash-dash-bang (one edit, verified against the rebuilt file: the header now opens with slash-dash-bang and closes with slash-dash). The build is the final authority: targeted build green (8848/8848), full tree green (17454/17454). LESSON: the header opener is now a recurring typo locus alongside the face-advancement line - the generator must assert the slash-dash-bang opener and slash-dash closer in its hygiene scans, and the doc-sweep should re-check it.

TALLY THROUGH WINDOW 82: 82 windows - 36 clean, 46 rescue; 68 total internal Rosser failures, ALL RECORDED (W82 adds two; W80's zero-failure record as the most recent clean window since W74 stands). Snap history: W1, W78, W82 (three snaps; none adjacent; no pattern claimed). W83 LAUNCHED in overlap: a83 = 12 363 155 097 114 (= b82 ACTUAL, post-snap), b requested = 12 363 155 117 114, 32 workers, cache seeded from window82_b82.json.cache.jsonl - the W82 seam was already audited, per the 0348 rule.

NO RH CLAIM: W82 is a certificate (finite-height extension of the verified band to 82 windows) and a formal re-anchor of the NAMED terminal face to tCE82. The open object is terminalFaceCE82 - the absolute clause [S1]/A1 (uniform data-free bound on S-at-zeros / DN walk) above 3 000 175 720 648 - equivalently the 0288 face. The M2 lane (pinned wall, 0350) and the queued formal units D1C (Danesh criterion) and SIs (Ismail [IS] input) remain the other live fronts; the Z78 strip strengthening remains unconsumed by the terminal face per the 0386 decision.
